official_metadata.setting: Outskirts of a French rail freight depot
official_metadata.official_description: A covert armory concealed inside an abandoned French wine storage warehouse and adjacent train depot. Features stacked intermodal shipping containers, stationary boxcars, interior mezzanine office perches, and mechanic bays.
official_metadata.provenance: Activision / Infinity Ward Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Official Intel

cut_the_cake_suitability.analysis_notes: Cut the Cake Inference: Stacked shipping containers produce non-convex occlusion volumes and partial elevated mantling routes.
